whatChanged.categoryZh: AI / 基础设施 / 融资
whatChanged.headline: Oracle Seeks $20 Billion for AI. Why Sell Shares and Bonds Together?
whatChanged.headlineZh: 甲骨文为 AI 再筹 200 亿美元，为什么发债还要卖股票？
intro: Oracle is asking investors for another $20 billion. Filings made on 2 November 2026 outline roughly $10 billion in bonds and a separate $10 billion common-stock offering, as the company expands its AI cloud infrastructure. The headline number is a financing plan, not proof that all the cash has already arrived.
The interesting question is why a company with large AI contracts needs to raise money in two different ways at once.
introZh: 甲骨文（Oracle）又要向资本市场筹钱了。2026 年 11 月 2 日的发行文件显示，公司计划发行约 100 亿美元债券，同时另行发行 100 亿美元普通股，为 AI 云基础设施扩张等企业需求提供资金。这是融资安排，不代表 200 亿美元已经全部到账。
既然 AI 订单需求很大，为什么还要同时借钱、卖股票？

sections.heading: What does each half of the financing do?
sections.headingZh: 发债和卖股票，区别在哪里？
paragraphs: Selling bonds is borrowing: investors provide cash now, and Oracle must pay interest and eventually repay principal. Selling common shares brings in equity capital without a fixed repayment date, but spreads ownership across more shares and can dilute existing shareholders.

The two offerings are legally separate. Oracle's preliminary bond prospectus says one can close without the other, and the company cannot guarantee that the stock offering will complete as proposed. Bond terms in that preliminary document still contained blanks, so the final coupon and proceeds should not be inferred from it.
paragraphsZh: 发债相当于借钱。投资者现在把钱交给 Oracle，公司之后要付利息、还本金。发行普通股则是引入股本，不需要按债券的方式定期还本付息，但原有股东的持股比例可能被摊薄。
这两笔发行是独立的。Oracle 的初步债券招股文件明确表示，债券与股票不必同时完成，公司也无法保证股票发行一定按计划完成。初步文件中部分债券利率等条款仍留空，不能把它当作已经完成定价的交易。

sections.heading: Why is the timing important?
sections.headingZh: 为什么现在筹钱值得关注？
paragraphs: In its June 2026 results, Oracle said it did not expect to issue more debt during calendar 2026. The 2 November proposed bond sale therefore marks a change from that earlier expectation. At its 28 October 2026 Investor Day, Oracle committed to limiting additional capital-market fundraising through fiscal 2030 to $20 billion, excluding refinancing of existing debt. It expects roughly $10 billion in equity and $10 billion in gross debt. The proposed November offerings match that expected split, bringing the immediate cost of building capacity into focus.

Oracle's November prospectus lists $125.3 billion in senior unsecured borrowings as of 31 August 2026. That figure is outstanding borrowing, not this week's new funding. The company expects AI cloud demand to support future growth, but contracted demand and revenue forecasts do not themselves pay today's construction bills.
paragraphsZh: Oracle 在 2026 年 6 月公布业绩时曾表示，预计 2026 自然年内不会再发行债券。2026 年 11 月 2 日的新债券发行计划，说明融资安排已与当时的预期不同。Oracle 在 2026 年 10 月 28 日投资者日表示，计划将截至 2030 财年的新增资本市场融资限制在 200 亿美元以内，不包括现有债务再融资；目前预计其中约 100 亿美元来自股权融资，另约 100 亿美元来自债务融资。11 月提出的两项发行计划与这一拆分预期一致，也让建设算力设施的眼前资金需求更受关注。
根据 Oracle 11 月的发行文件，截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日，公司已有约 1,253 亿美元高级无担保借款。这是此前累积的借款余额，不是本周新借的钱。AI 客户合同和未来收入预期可以支持扩张计划，却不能自动变成今天建设数据中心的现金。

sections.heading: Where will the money go?
sections.headingZh: 200 亿美元都会用来买 AI 芯片吗？
paragraphs: The filing permits broad corporate uses: capital spending, repayment of debt, investments or acquisitions, dividends and share repurchases. It would be inaccurate to say that every dollar is earmarked for new AI chips. Reuters connects the fundraising to Oracle's data-centre expansion, while the legal document allows a wider set of uses.
The useful distinction is between a company expecting future AI revenue and a company having enough cash today to build the facilities needed to earn it.
paragraphsZh: 不能这样说。文件列出的用途很宽，包括资本开支、偿还旧债、投资或收购、派息和股票回购。路透社将融资与 AI 云基础设施扩张联系起来，但法律文件没有规定所有资金必须投向新芯片。
关键区别在于：未来可能获得的 AI 收入，并不等于今天就有足够的现金去建设兑现这些收入所需的设施。

whatChanged.ending: AI capacity can be sold years ahead; the money to build it is needed much sooner.
whatChanged.endingZh: AI 算力可以提前签下多年订单，建造它所需的钱却要现在拿出来。

stayCurious.categoryZh: 新加坡 / 地名 / 语言
stayCurious.headline: Bukit Timah Means “Tin Hill”. So Where Was the Tin?
stayCurious.headlineZh: 武吉知马的意思是“锡山”，可这里真的有锡吗？
intro: Bukit Timah is one of Singapore's best-known place names. In Malay, bukit means hill and timah means tin. But the National Heritage Board says no tin was ever discovered in the area. So why does a hill with no known tin deposits carry that name?
introZh: 武吉知马（Bukit Timah）这个名字，按马来语直译是“锡山”：bukit 是山丘，timah 是锡。可新加坡国家文物局说，这一带从未发现过锡。一个没有锡的地方，怎么会叫“锡山”？

sections.heading: Could the name have come from a tree?
sections.headingZh: 名字可能来自一棵树吗？
paragraphs: The National Heritage Board's Bukit Timah Heritage Trail booklet offers a possible explanation: local people may once have called the hill Bukit Temak, after trees growing there. When the name was written down in English, Temak may have become Timah.

The booklet is careful about the uncertainty. Historians have not conclusively identified which tree the word temak referred to, although Shorea curtisii, also called Seraya, is considered a likely candidate. Early British maps recorded variants including Bukit Tima and Bukit Teemar. These spellings show how a spoken place name could change as it passed between languages and maps; they do not prove exactly who changed it.
paragraphsZh: 新加坡国家文物局的《武吉知马文化遗产步道》手册提出一种可能：当地人原本把山丘叫作 Bukit Temak，指这里生长的 Temak 树。后来这个名字被用英文记录时，Temak 可能逐渐变成了 Timah。
但这不是已经坐实的定论。手册说，Temak 究竟对应哪种树还不明确，常见的 Seraya 树（学名 Shorea curtisii）是一个可能的答案。19 世纪的英国地图还出现过 Bukit Tima、Bukit Teemar 等不同拼法。它们让人看到地名在口语、地图和不同语言之间流转的痕迹，却不能证明具体是谁把名字改成了今天这样。

sections.heading: Was the hill important for a different kind of rock?
sections.headingZh: 那么，这里以前挖过什么？
paragraphs: Yes. Granite quarrying was part of Bukit Timah's history. A 2019 National Heritage Board magazine article describes granite quarrying around Bukit Timah, noting that quarries including Hindhede expanded as demand grew for stone used in projects such as the Causeway. Granite is not tin, and quarrying is not evidence of tin mining.
The area's history also includes forest, plantations, transport and industry. Its name, however, may preserve an older reference to vegetation rather than a mineral deposit.
paragraphsZh: 这里确实有采石历史，不过开采的是花岗岩，不是锡。国家文物局 2019 年的《MUSE SG》文章介绍了武吉知马的花岗岩采石业，并指出包括 Hindhede Quarry 在内的采石场随着工程用石需求增长而发展，相关工程包括新柔长堤。
武吉知马后来还经历过种植园、交通建设和工业发展。今天这个听起来与矿产有关的名字，可能反而保留了更早的森林记忆。

sections.heading: Do historians agree on one origin?
sections.headingZh: 地名的来历已经确定了吗？
paragraphs: Not entirely. The tree explanation is supported as a possibility by the official heritage trail booklet. An older National Heritage Board magazine also records an alternative suggestion that Timah may relate to the name Fatimah. Neither account establishes an undisputed origin.
That is the interesting part: a literal translation can be certain while the historical reason for a name remains unresolved.
paragraphsZh: 还没有。官方文化遗产步道将 Temak 树的说法列为可能解释；国家文物局较早的刊物还记录了另一种猜测：Timah 也可能与人名 Fatimah 有关。这些都不是经过最终证实的唯一答案。
我们可以确定 Bukit Timah 的字面意思，却仍无法完全确定当初为什么这样叫它。

stayCurious.ending: Sometimes the most familiar name on a map is the one that still has a question mark beside it.
stayCurious.endingZh: 每天路过的熟悉地名，可能恰好藏着一个还没有标准答案的问题。
